blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth (SALN) form does not have a section where public officials could list their acquisition costs for their business interests, a records officer from the Office of the Ombudsman said on Tuesday during Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. Earlier, Atty. Karen S. Batu, Officer-in-Charge, Records Division of the Office of the Ombudsman, testified that though Duterte listed several business interests of which she was the incorporator or stockholder from 2007 to 2012 and from 2016 to 2025, the vice president did not declare any acquisition costs for such.
